per_item.question: List the names of all students.
What is the average GPA of all students?
List the names of students with a GPA above 3.5.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5;
per_item.pred_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5;

per_item.question: How many students are in each department? Show the department name and the count.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(s.student_id) FROM departments d LEFT JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id;

per_item.question: Which department has the highest budget? Return its name.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM departments ORDER BY budget DESC LIMIT 1;

per_item.question: List the titles of courses offered by the Computer Science department.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT c.title FROM courses c JOIN departments d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science';

per_item.question: What is the name of the student with the highest GPA?
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1;

per_item.question: How many courses is each student enrolled in? Show student name and count.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(e.course_id) FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id;

per_item.question: List the names of departments that have more than 2 students.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT d.name FROM departments d JOIN students s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_id HAVING COUNT(s.student_id) > 2;

per_item.question: What is the average grade in the course titled 'Algorithms'?
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(e.grade) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Algorithms';

per_item.question: List the names of students enrolled in the 'Databases' course.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases';

per_item.question: How many students enrolled in each year? Show the year and the count.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT enrolled_year, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY enrolled_year;

per_item.question: Which student has taken the most courses? Return their name.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY COUNT(e.course_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

per_item.question: List the names of students who are not enrolled in any course.
per_item.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments);
